instruction: Grab the cylindrical drinking mug black color on the table, rotate it, set it down in the middle, then hang it onto the rack with straight and slanted rods.

source.instruction: Grab the cylindrical drinking mug black color on the table, rotate it, set it down in the middle, then hang it onto the rack with straight and slanted rods.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the mug, which was at x = -23 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the mug, which was at x = +0 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Orient left gripper down and align above the rim of the mug near (-16, -3, 94).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+14, +16, +0) cm, now 7 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the mug

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-16, -3, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper closer to the rim to z = 90 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -5) cm, now 7 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the mug

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-16, -3, 90) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left fingertips to z = 85 cm into the mug rim and grasp.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -5) cm, now 7 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the mug; closed the gripper (opening 0.09: holding the mug)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-16, -3, 85) opening 0.09; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift mug vertically to z = 93 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +8) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the mug

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-16, -3, 93) opening 0.09; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move mug toward center-front at (8, -17, 93) to reorient and set down.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+24, -14, +0) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the mug

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (8, -17, 93) opening 0.09; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate mug yaw -20 degrees and lower slightly to z = 90 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, -3) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the mug

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (8, -17, 90) opening 0.09; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74

frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-1, -0, -5) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the mug

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (7, -17, 86) opening 0.09; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Open left gripper to release mug.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the mug; opened the gripper

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (7, -17, 86) opening 0.92; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Retract left arm up to z = 96 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +10) cm, now 8 cm (horizontal) / +22 cm (vertical) from the mug

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (7, -17, 96) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74

frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-37, -2, -2) cm, now 30 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the mug; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-13, -0, +0) cm, now 18 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the mug

frames.label: turn 11
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (18, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74

frames.label: turn 12
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (5, -12, 90) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right gripper to z = 85 cm and grasp mug rim.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -5) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the mug; closed the gripper (opening 0.08: holding the mug)

frames.label: turn 14

frames.label: turn 15
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (4, 1, 107) opening 0.09; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower slightly to z = 100 cm and tilt wrist roll/pitch/yaw to angle handle toward slanted peg.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -7) cm, now 10 cm (horizontal) / -6 cm (vertical) from the mug

frames.label: turn 16
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (4, 1, 100) opening 0.08; table z = 74
frames.plan: Translate mug forward and down toward peg at (3, 7, 89).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-1, +6, -11) cm, now 10 cm (horizontal) / -6 cm (vertical) from the mug

frames.plan: Move mug onto the peg and lower to z = 82 cm onto the peg.

frames.label: turn 18
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, 9, 82) opening 0.09; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower slightly to z = 81 cm and open right gripper to hang the mug.
